versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "asking-until-100" skill for OpenClaw.
- Introduces structured questioning protocol to clarify tasks before execution, focusing on coding, build, architecture, and debugging.
- Implements readiness estimation and adjustable questioning modes (fast, guided, deep, report) based on ambiguity and rigor.
- Enforces high-rigor question reports for critical coding/build tasks, including provisional project structure and decision-critical unknowns.
- Integrates repo awareness to avoid unnecessary questions and references supporting scripts and configuration options.
